timelineEvents.title: Music studies at the Chopin Music School in Warsaw
timelineEvents.label: c. 1920–1925 · Music studies in Warsaw
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper studies piano and composition in Warsaw while building a strong theoretical musical foundation.
timelineEvents.longDescription: His training includes piano, theory, harmony, counterpoint, composition, form, and orchestration. Achieves exceptional theoretical knowledge - able to identify complex harmonies and progressions by ear alone.

timelineEvents.title: Public performance at the Chopin Music School concert
timelineEvents.label: 1925 · Chopin School public performance
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper performs Chopin in a public concert as a pupil of Józef Śmidowicz’s piano class.
timelineEvents.longDescription: In June, appears at a public concert of the Fryderyk Chopin Higher School of Music at the Warsaw Philharmonic as a pupil of Józef Śmidowicz’s piano class. Performs the first movement of Chopin’s Piano Concerto in F minor. Warsaw critics note his “light finger technique” and “elegance combined with concentrated lyricism,”
